title: microC: A 3D virtual microenvironment for perturbation biology
author: Dimitrios Voukantsis
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.wtjfekn

steps.title: Access the microC platform
steps.instruction: Navigate to the microC main web page at microc.org.

steps.title: Configure experiment parameters
steps.instruction: Define the experimental setup using the interface tools.

substeps.instruction: Set numerical parameters using the provided sliders.
Specify the gene network, mutations, and diffusion control parameters.
Enable specific microC modules by configuring specification files (e.g., setting parameters for Oxygen or any output node within diffusion-parameters.txt to enable a diffusion module).
Upload local files that define the experiment using the 'Choose File' button.
Select either the 2D or 3D simulating environment using the check box.

steps.title: Submit the experiment
steps.instruction: Click the 'Run experiment' button to submit the experiment to the computing cluster.

steps.title: Monitor experiment status
steps.instruction: Use the provided submission link to track the progress of the simulation.

substeps.instruction: Check the link for status information and the log file to identify potential errors.
Wait for the experiment to finish; results will become available in batches of 16 replicates.
Optionally, monitor for an email notification of completion.

steps.title: Analyze simulation results
steps.instruction: Review the data on the results page.

substeps.instruction: View the animation of all replicates on the initial page.
Inspect averaged and detailed data for each experimental replicate.
Click specific icons to access more detailed information on individual replicates.
Review graphs on cell populations and cell decisions.
